entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this and it's not right.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Miller, order number VF77891. It's for the ProFit Jersey. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this is just... it's really upsetting. I was counting on this.

Okay, Sarah, I have your order right here. I appreciate your loyalty with us. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the size. I always get a medium, but this one is the wrong size entirely. It's way too tight across the shoulders. I can barely move in it. I feel terrible, I was so excited to wear it.
I understand, getting the fit wrong is definitely frustrating. Let me just pull up our policy for you. I see here the order was delivered six days ago.
Yes, just a few days. I really hope this isn't a problem. With the holidays, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.

It is absolutely no problem at all, Sarah. For a standard apparel item like this jersey, we have a 90-day return policy. You are well within that timeframe. I can process this for you right now. Would you prefer an exchange for a larger size, or would you like a full refund?
Oh! A full refund? Are you sure? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I have just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the item back up, apply the label, and drop it at any post office. You'll see the refund post to your original payment method about 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That's wonderful. You've really helped me out, Isaac. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, and happy holidays.
Happy holidays to you too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
